metadata.source_name: Pacers contracts dataset plus published Spotrac NBA cap and tax pages
metadata.notes: team_salary is calculated from current-season salary values in pacers-contracts.json only. Ethan Thompson is excluded because his 2025-26 salary remains unverified and is null in pacers-contracts.json. Dead money, cap holds, incentives, and tax-only allocation adjustments are not included in team_salary.
